'''Ice fuses''' were a valuable commodity on the [[Invisible Market|Black Market]]. They were some of the goods stolen by the [[Eiattu pirates|TIE Pirates]] before they were stopped by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
